text: Someone shadowing before their real role starts can watch how the practice runs, without changing anything. That's the Observer role.
The one thing to remember: an Observer can look, and is meant to change nothing.
This is Kai, shadowing this week.
There's no booking, new-client or task button on the left.
there's nothing to click: no voids, no credits.
Kai can read payments, appointments, memberships, inventory and patient reports.
When their real role starts, add it, then take Observer off.
The most common mistake is leaving Observer on after the real role is added.
Remember: an Observer can look, and is meant to change nothing.
